_source: code/config/pipeline_config.yaml (simulation.thermal_3d, simulation.thermomechanical, uq.variants.no_hr) and results/metrics/tilt_offset_no_hr.json, state of 2026-10-09; calibration values of 2026-11-04 (two convection factors)

input_channels._note: model input -> default MKP channel name (sensors.mkp of code/config/pipeline_config.yaml); wind speed is not measured by MKP

convection_factors._note: two independent LogNormal convection factors of the 2-D calibration (calibration_results/Table_01, Embedded): ln c_j ~ N(ln median_j, sigma_ln_j^2), c_top on the deck top (tag 9), c_ext on all other external faces (tags 8 and 0); propagated as c_j = median_j * exp(sigma_ln_j * xi_j) on the tensor Gauss-Hermite rule in (xi_top, xi_ext), as in the calibration (order 4: 5 x 5 nodes)

uncertainty._n_quadrature_nodes_note: Gauss-Hermite nodes per factor; the model runs at n_quadrature_nodes ** 2 parameter combinations

default_noise_std._source: 0 for every quantity: only the embedded MFU (and, for temperatures, the position) is propagated; the calibrated residual sigma_k belongs to the measured pilot sensors and is added only when noise_std is passed explicitly (paper Sec. 3.5)

noise_std_by_member._source: calibrated noise of the pilot sensor in the same member (residual model error and measurement noise, 2-D calibration, calibration_results/Table_01, Embedded, step 3); for reference only, not added to virtual sensors

position._note: sensor-position uncertainty of temperature virtual sensors (law of total variance, paper Eq. totvar); prior of src/nibelungen_virtual_sensors/position.py: depth behind the cavity face uniform on [min(d_text, d_ifc) - tolerance_m, max(d_text, d_ifc) + tolerance_m], in the face plane (across and along z) N(0, in_plane_std_m^2), clipped into the member with mapping.margin_m of ifc_config.json; n_samples fixed-seed scrambled Sobol points (seed + index of the member). Defined by the authors, same as code/studies/position_uncertainty. seed 20261023 = study seed 20261013 + 10, so the E+23.3 samples are those of the study. transform(position_uncertainty=False) switches the term off.
